commands:
set -eu
systemctl is-active fyp-p82-stop.timer
cd /opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1
runuser -u fyp -- env P8_DOCKER_DATA_PATH=/srv/fyp-p82 .venv/bin/python -c 'from pathlib import Path; from research.execution_linux_v1.platform import host; from research.execution_setup.resources import admission; import json; sample=host(Path("/srv/fyp-p82"),Path("/srv/fyp-p82-backup")); admission(sample); print(json.dumps(sample))'
sha256sum /tmp/linux-source.tar.gz /tmp/qualification.zip
systemctl start --no-block fyp-p82-qualification.service
systemctl show fyp-p82-qualification.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp
